title: When Extreme Darkness Meets Motion Blur: MeanFlow for Unified RAW Restoration
abstract: arXiv:2608.01720v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Extremely low-light RAW enhancement aims to recover severely attenuated sensor signals, yet existing methods often focus on illumination and noise while overlooking the motion-induced degradations inherent in practical low-light imaging. We present a framework for robust extremely low-light RAW enhancement under realistic acquisition degradations. First, we introduce See in the Degraded Extremely Dark (SIDED), a new dataset that applies controlled motion degradation to extremely low-light RAW pairs while retaining their original sensor noise. Second, we propose a unified RAW tokenizer equipped with explicit domain-conditioned representation calibration to align extremely low-light and well-exposed RAW data, followed by a MeanFlow that performs enhancement in a single function evaluation. translated_title: 当极端黑暗遇上运动模糊：面向统一RAW复原的MeanFlow
translated_abstract: 极低照度RAW增强旨在恢复严重衰减的传感器信号，然而现有方法通常只关注光照与噪声，而忽视了实际低照度成像中固有的由运动引起的退化。我们提出了一个在真实采集退化条件下鲁棒的极低照度RAW增强框架。首先，我们引入了See in the Degraded Extremely Dark（SIDED），这是一个新数据集，它在保留原始传感器噪声的同时，对极低照度RAW图像对施加受控的运动退化。其次，我们提出了一个统一的RAW分词器，配备显式的域条件表示校准，以对齐极低照度RAW数据与曝光良好的RAW数据，随后采用MeanFlow在单次函数评估中完成增强。据我们所知，这是首个在真实运动退化采集条件下对极低照度RAW增强问题进行建模并加以解决的工作。
tldr: 该工作首个在真实运动模糊退化条件下研究极低照度RAW图像增强，提出含运动退化的SIDED数据集，并采用带域条件表示校准的统一RAW分词器与单步推理的MeanFlow模型，实现高质量统一复原。
en_tdlr: This is the first work to formulate extremely low-light RAW enhancement under realistic motion-degraded acquisition, introducing the SIDED dataset and combining a unified RAW tokenizer with domain-conditioned calibration and a single-step MeanFlow for high-quality unified restoration.
